text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer, is there such a thing 
as a "Hot Delivery Service"~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she walked into the trainer's 
office, Hishi Akebono asked a rather 
strange question.
choice_data_list: I don't think so... Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Actually, I got a letter addressed 
to me~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"‘I love Bono-san's races! She's so huge 
and chugs along like a truck!’ it says♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy that I was going to write a 
reply, but Mom wrote, 'You must be busy, 
so no need to write back'~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So instead of a reply letter, I was 
thinking how about sending some homemade 
"Nankai Chanko Nabe" or something~♪
choice_data_list:
Are you sure they won't mind receiving 
that...?

Are you sure they won't mind receiving 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Well, either way, we can't send it 
without "Hot Express Delivery" anyway~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! In that case, I'll send some 
homemade 'Tub Ice Cream' via refrigerated 
delivery!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta go prep the ingredients right 
away♪ Just heading to the local 
supermarket...
choice_data_list: Let's just give a normal reply!
Let's just go with a normal reply!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hastily stopped Hishi Akebono from 
starting her prep. It seemed the letter 
had brought her a joy too big to fit in 
any bowl.
